description: Preview, by default, the opt-in post-merge workflow (.github/workflows/orangepro-proof.yml: contents: read, no secrets, pinned actions) and the .orangepro/actions/ folder it reads (the profile: target, oracle, fault, selected tests, the test to replay). Writes nothing unless dry_run is false and confirm is "install" (or "uninstall" with uninstall: true). Never commits, pushes, creates secrets, grants permissions or opens pull requests; a file changed since OrangePro wrote it is reported as a conflict and never overwritten or removed. Tested locally; a real Actions run is separate.

base.description: Branch whose pushes start the workflow. Default: the remote's default branch, else main.

build_sha256.description: That version's build stamp. Default: this build's.

confirm.description: Required with dry_run: false; must match the action.

deliver.description: Opt-in: add the separate deliver job that opens one draft test PR for a verified gap (the only job with write permissions; it runs no repository code).

opro_version.description: OrangePro version the workflow installs. Default: this one.

profile_from.description: Folder holding profile.json and the files it names. Needed to install.

uninstall.description: Remove the files OrangePro wrote (only those still unchanged).

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

name: orangepro_install_github_action
title: Install the post-merge GitHub Actions workflow
